decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's psychiatric expertise. It moved to the home page in 2024, and the firm's own R&D helps it learn from early results and refine the service.
Senior living counseling draws directly on the firm's core eldercare knowledge and has been featured on the home page in both years, which signals sustained commitment.

The retail shop builds on the established sheltered workshop production know-how and was promoted to the home page in 2024. The carpentry offshoot was discontinued, but this product shows growing visibility.
Meal delivery is new and only mentioned so far, but it sits close to the firm's eldercare services and kitchen capabilities, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it.
